seed: A transition's end follows the pointer while you drag it, with its length in a bubble beside the pointer (user report 2026-09-29: the band only changed size when the mouse came up). At Next defaults with no flag changed: two clips meet on V1 with spare either side and a cross dissolve goes across the cut; each end of its band is pulled by real mouse moves, reading where the end was drawn after every one against where the pointer was. Then it is pulled into the stop the spare media puts on it, called off with Escape, undone, moved to one side of the cut, and the same is done to a transition on a clip's own join.

steps.control: Edit point Tutorial Sample to b-roll
Transition Tutorial Sample to b-roll end

steps.note: THE FIRST TEST: the band's right end, pulled right in twenty small real mouse moves, was drawn under the pointer at every one of them, and the bubble beside the pointer said the length the whole way. Across the cut the left end moves out by the same amount, so the band grew by twice the travel

steps.control: Transition Tutorial Sample to b-roll start

steps.note: THE SECOND TEST: its left end, pulled left, did the same

steps.control: Transition Tutorial Sample to b-roll end

steps.note: THE THIRD TEST: pulled far past what the cut can pay for. The end followed the pointer until the spare ran out at two seconds, then stopped with the pointer moving on, and the bubble turned amber and said max. Letting go landed exactly the length it showed, with no jump

steps.control: Transition Tutorial Sample to b-roll end

steps.note: THE FOURTH TEST: Escape half way through a drag put the band back as it was, and the rest of the gesture did nothing
One undo takes back the whole of the last drag, back to the length the two small pulls left it at

steps.control: Transition Tutorial Sample to b-roll end

steps.note: THE FIFTH TEST: a transition placed after its cut starts on the cut, so only its far end is a grip, and that end follows the pointer too

steps.control: Tutorial Sample transition at join 1 end
Tutorial Sample transition at join 1 start

steps.note: THE SIXTH TEST, and the one the user hit: a transition on a join inside one clip (cut with the blade, the middle thrown away). Both of its ends followed the pointer at every move, where before this they stayed put until the button came up
